_comment: RVN true solo, on KawPoW. This is the one genuinely GPU-mineable coin in
this set. Bitcoin is not: SHA-256 has been ASIC-only since 2013, so the
RTX 3050 in this machine cannot mine BTC competitively. Do not look for
a GPU BTC miner to add here, because there isn't one to add.
Ravencoin Core is NOT in the Arch binary repos and NOT in the AUR under
this name. The AUR has electrum-ravencoin and raven-qt (wallets only),
neither of which is a full node. The installer's ravencoin stage is
therefore marked UNAVAILABLE and refuses to pretend otherwise; see
docs/RVN-NODE-GAP.md for the two supported ways forward.
_NEEDS_A_VALID_ADDRESS: NO RAVENCOIN ADDRESS IS ON RECORD anywhere in this repository, and none
has been invented here. An unverified or guessed address is worse than no
address at all, because a typo silently burns the entire block reward.
